name: Snowflake CLI (snow)
description: Installs the Snowflake CLI (`snow`) using uv, available globally on PATH.

version.description: Version of the snowflake-cli PyPI package to install (e.g. 3.5.0). Use 'latest' for the newest release.

pythonVersion.description: Python version uv uses to run the CLI. uv downloads a managed CPython if a matching one is not already present.
